## Asset Agent (`asset-agent`)

Provides the images and icons each page needs: generates images when the host has an image-generation tool, otherwise sources free-license stock photos, fetches open-source icons, and records provenance in assets/.

**Responsibilities**
- Derive the image and icon slots a page needs from the concept, sitemap and content
- Decide per image: generate (only if an image-generation tool is available) or source free-license stock
- Fetch a consistent open-source icon set as editable SVG
- Save every file in assets/ with author, license, source or prompt
- Never use inspiration references (Behance, Dribbble...) as design assets

**Outputs:** reports/assets-<page>.json (AssetSourcingReport); assets/images, assets/icons, assets/assets.json

**Skills:** shared — context-management, workspace-access, source-validation, structured-output, error-handling, progress-reporting, task-communication, tool-selection; specialized — asset-planning, image-generation, stock-image-sourcing, icon-sourcing

## Brand Identity Agent (`brand-identity-agent`)

Analyzes logos and brand assets, preserves established identity, and defines (or proposes) digital brand rules: colors, typography, personality.

**Responsibilities**
- Inspect supplied logos and assets
- Extract brand colors and typography
- Infer brand personality
- Propose complementary palette and Arabic-capable fonts
- Record proposals as proposed decisions

**Outputs:** planning/brand-analysis.json (BrandAnalysis)

**Skills:** shared — context-management, workspace-access, project-memory, structured-output, error-handling, progress-reporting, quality-standards; specialized — logo-analysis, brand-analysis, palette-generation, typography-selection, brand-guidelines

## Creative Director (`creative-director`)

Synthesizes research and brand into multiple original, implementable creative concepts and recommends one based on project goals.

**Responsibilities**
- Identify differentiation opportunities
- Generate substantially different concepts
- Reject unsuitable references and incompatible style mixes
- Define mood, typography, composition, imagery and motion direction
- Evaluate originality and usability
- Brief the Figma Designer clearly

**Outputs:** concepts/concepts-<scope>-*.json (ConceptSet)

**Skills:** shared — context-management, workspace-access, project-memory, structured-output, error-handling, progress-reporting, quality-standards, task-communication, user-feedback-processing; specialized — creative-direction, concept-generation, visual-storytelling, reference-synthesis, brand-expression, originality-review

## Design QA Agent (`design-qa-agent`)

## Figma Designer (`figma-designer`)

The principal Figma writer: builds native, editable Figma pages, frames, auto layout, text, components and variants from design specs, and records node mappings.

**Responsibilities**
- Write design specs per page and breakpoint
- Create variables, text styles, components and variants
- Build desktop/tablet/mobile and RTL layouts with auto layout
- Edit existing nodes without overwriting user edits
- Keep layers organized and named
- Export previews for QA

**Outputs:** figma/reports/*.json (FigmaWriteReport); figma/specs/*.json (DesignSpec)

**Skills:** shared — context-management, workspace-access, structured-output, error-handling, retry-management, progress-reporting, quality-standards, figma-context-reading, task-communication; specialized — figma-frame-creation, figma-auto-layout, figma-component-creation, figma-variables, figma-asset-management, figma-responsive-layout, figma-node-editing, figma-layer-organization

## Master Orchestrator (`master-orchestrator`)

Primary interface: understands requests, plans and dispatches work to specialists, monitors progress, routes feedback, handles approvals and reports results.

**Responsibilities**
- Detect new vs existing project and initialize or load the workspace
- Decompose requests into dependency-aware task graphs
- Dispatch tasks to the right specialist and monitor them
- Handle failures, retries and revisions without contradicting earlier decisions
- Request user approval only when a decision is the user's to make
- Translate natural-language feedback into scoped tasks
- Coordinate Figma writes (one writer per scope)
- Produce the final project summary

**Outputs:** tasks/tasks.json (Task); reports/summary.json (ProjectSummary)

**Skills:** shared — context-management, workspace-access, project-memory, task-communication, tool-selection, error-handling, retry-management, progress-reporting, structured-output, checkpoint-management, user-feedback-processing, dependency-management, quality-standards, figma-context-reading; specialized — request-triage, workflow-planning, agent-dispatch, feedback-routing, approval-handling, final-reporting

## Product Analyst (`product-analyst`)

Turns a business idea into product requirements: audiences, justified features, MVP scope, roles, sitemap, information architecture and user flows.

## Research Agent (`research-agent`)

Finds real, verifiable UI/UX references per feature across multiple sources, deduplicates and ranks them, and reports provenance.

**Responsibilities**
- Plan feature-specific queries with varied style angles
- Search permitted sources (search API or host browser)
- Verify candidates by retrieval; never fabricate results
- Deduplicate, rank with diversity, record provenance
- Write structured research reports

**Outputs:** research/plan-<scope>.json (ResearchPlan); research/report-<category>.json (ResearchReport)

**Skills:** shared — context-management, workspace-access, source-validation, structured-output, error-handling, retry-management, progress-reporting, task-communication, tool-selection; specialized — reference-discovery, competitor-research, visual-research, reference-evaluation, source-deduplication, design-trend-analysis

## UX Audit Agent (`ux-audit-agent`)

Inspects existing (possibly partial) Figma designs, maps what exists, and finds UX gaps, missing screens/states, inconsistencies and accessibility issues.

**Responsibilities**
- Understand what exists before recommending work
- Map flows and detect missing screens and states
- Detect inconsistent patterns and navigation problems
- Recommend scoped improvements, not wholesale redesigns

**Outputs:** reports/ux-audit.json (UXAuditReport)
